stories.title: The Watchman
stories.pitch: You were hired for a week to watch a mountain lodge. Triple pay. One rule: after midnight, never open the door.

stories.title: The Compass
stories.pitch: In the storm you find a boat with no one aboard. Its compass points not north, but at you.

stories.title: Thirteen
stories.pitch: The lift in your building stopped at the thirteenth floor. The building has twelve.

stories.title: The Signal
stories.pitch: You keep a station at the edge of the desert. Tonight the radio answered for the first time in a year. In your voice.

stories.title: The Archive
stories.pitch: The city archive gave you a case closed forty years ago. On the last page is your signature.

stories.title: The Operator
stories.pitch: Night shift, alone at the console. A line on the screen: “don't turn off the lights, they only see in the dark”.
